# Tigreal Second-Engage Doctrine

Tigreal becomes premium when he closes the window after space is already destabilized.

## What to watch

- Hold him off-screen long enough to distort enemy facing.
- Use fog and lane timing as the real setup layer.
- Trap the damage line, not just the tank line.

## Why it matters

Roam value becomes expensive when the second engage feels inevitable instead of theatrical.

> Draft him to close the window after it opens.

More on Tigreal: keep this read connected to tank roam structures, not just isolated mechanics.
